Chapter 1: Executive Summary

Vaididea is a comprehensive digital healthcare ecosystem designed to make healthcare more connected, accessible, and intelligent across India. It is not just a telemedicine application or a doctor-booking platform—it is a complete healthcare operating system that seamlessly connects patients, doctors, hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, diagnostic centers, and ambulance services into a single, integrated platform.

The Healthcare Problem

India’s healthcare ecosystem remains highly fragmented. Patients often struggle to find the right healthcare provider, maintain medical records, coordinate prescriptions, diagnostic tests, and emergency services. Healthcare providers also operate through disconnected systems, resulting in delays, inefficiencies, and a poor patient experience.

These challenges affect both urban and rural India. While urban populations face overcrowded hospitals, long waiting times, and fragmented healthcare services, rural and semi-urban communities continue to experience shortages of specialists, longer travel distances, and limited healthcare accessibility.

The Vaididea Solution

Vaididea unifies the entire healthcare journey into one intelligent platform.

  1. Patients can consult verified doctors, book appointments, maintain digital health records, order medicines, schedule diagnostic tests, and access emergency services from a single application.
  2. Doctors, hospitals, clinics, pharmacies, diagnostic centers, and ambulance providers work together through one connected ecosystem, enabling faster collaboration, secure information sharing, and better continuity of care.
  3. In medical emergencies, a single SOS instantly connects ambulances, nearby hospitals, doctors, and family members, significantly reducing response time when every second matters.

Built for Every Indian

Vaididea is designed to serve India’s rapidly growing digital healthcare market while ensuring that quality healthcare reaches underserved communities as well. The platform provides a modern healthcare experience for urban users and includes offline capabilities, multilingual support, and low-bandwidth optimization, allowing the same ecosystem to effectively serve rural and semi-urban regions.

By building one unified healthcare platform for patients and providers alike, Vaididea aims to improve accessibility, efficiency, affordability, and continuity of care across India—regardless of where a patient lives.

Chapter 2: The Healthcare Challenge — Why Vaididea Exists

2.1 A Fragmented Healthcare Ecosystem

India has one of the world’s largest healthcare systems, yet the patient journey remains highly fragmented. Patients often use different platforms for doctor consultations, hospitals, pharmacies, diagnostic centers, ambulance services, and medical records. As a result, healthcare becomes time-consuming, expensive, and inefficient.

These challenges affect every section of society. Urban populations struggle with overcrowded hospitals, long waiting times, and disconnected healthcare services, while rural and semi-urban communities face additional barriers such as limited specialist availability, longer travel distances, and inconsistent internet connectivity.

Common Challenges Across India

  • Multiple applications are required for consultations, medicines, diagnostics, and emergency services.
  • Medical records remain scattered across different hospitals and clinics.
  • Long waiting times even after booking appointments.
  • Poor coordination between doctors, pharmacies, laboratories, and hospitals.
  • Emergency response often lacks real-time coordination among healthcare providers.

2.2 Accessibility Challenges Beyond Cities

Although digital healthcare has grown rapidly, accessibility remains inconsistent across different regions of India.

Urban Challenges

  • Overcrowded hospitals and clinics.
  • Long appointment waiting periods.
  • Increasing consultation costs.
  • Lack of integrated healthcare records.
  • Time lost travelling through traffic and waiting for consultations.

Rural & Semi-Urban Challenges

  • Limited availability of specialists.
  • Longer travel distances for quality healthcare.
  • Unstable internet connectivity in several locations.
  • Limited access to integrated healthcare services.
  • Greater dependency on local pharmacies and delayed medical intervention.

These differences highlight an important fact: while the nature of the challenge varies, the underlying healthcare experience remains fragmented across the country.

2.3 Limitations of Existing Digital Healthcare Platforms

Most existing healthcare applications solve only one part of the healthcare journey. Patients still need different services for consultation, medicines, diagnostics, emergency care, and medical records.

3.4 Design Philosophy

Vaididea follows a platform-first architecture, where every component of the healthcare ecosystem works together seamlessly. Rather than offering isolated services, the platform ensures that consultations, prescriptions, diagnostics, pharmacies, hospitals, ambulance services, and digital medical records remain connected throughout the patient’s healthcare journey.

The platform is designed with a strong emphasis on reliability, security, scalability, and interoperability. Advanced technologies such as cloud infrastructure, Artificial Intelligence, secure data management, and intelligent synchronization operate behind the scenes, allowing users to experience a simple, fast, and dependable healthcare system without needing to understand the underlying technical complexity.

This philosophy enables Vaididea to deliver a consistent healthcare experience across urban, semi-urban, and rural India while remaining adaptable to future technological advancements and healthcare requirements.

Chapter 3: The Vaididea Ecosystem & Platform Overview

3.1 The Vaididea Ecosystem at a Glance

Vaididea is a comprehensive digital healthcare ecosystem that brings together every major stakeholder in the healthcare journey on a single integrated platform. Rather than providing only online consultations, Vaididea enables seamless collaboration between patients, healthcare professionals, hospitals, pharmacies, diagnostic centers, ambulance services, and administrators.

The platform is organized into three major operational layers, ensuring that healthcare services remain connected from consultation to treatment and emergency response.

A. User Applications

The user applications are designed to provide patients and emergency responders with easy access to healthcare services anytime and anywhere.

Patient Application

The Vaididea Patient App serves as a comprehensive digital healthcare companion, enabling users to manage their healthcare journey from a single application. It provides convenient access to consultations, medical records, emergency services, wellness tracking, and AI-powered healthcare assistance.

Key capabilities include:

  • Book appointments with verified doctors and healthcare providers.
  • Consult doctors through video, audio, or chat.
  • Access digital medical records, prescriptions, and consultation history.
  • Order medicines from nearby pharmacies and schedule diagnostic tests.
  • Track daily nutrition, calorie intake, water consumption, and overall health through the integrated Food Tracking module.
  • Monitor physical activities such as steps, walking distance, and other wellness metrics through Google Health Connect integration.
  • Use Guardian Services, allowing trusted family members or guardians to receive emergency alerts, live location, and critical health notifications during SOS situations.
  • Trigger Emergency SOS to quickly notify ambulances, healthcare providers, guardians, and nearby emergency contacts.
  • Receive AI-powered healthcare assistance, including symptom guidance, nutrition recommendations, and personalized health insights.
  • Continue accessing essential healthcare services through intelligent offline capabilities and automatic synchronization when internet connectivity becomes available.

Ambulance Application

The Ambulance App helps emergency response teams receive emergency requests quickly, navigate to patients efficiently, and coordinate with hospitals during critical situations, reducing response time when every minute matters.

Healthcare Provider Platform

Vaididea provides dedicated web portals and mobile applications for every healthcare stakeholder, allowing each service provider to manage their operations through one unified ecosystem.

The platform includes dedicated modules for:

  • Doctors — Manage appointments, consult patients, issue digital prescriptions, review medical history, and provide follow-up care.
  • Hospitals & Clinics — Coordinate doctors, manage appointments, monitor operations, and support emergency care.
  • Pharmacies — Receive digital prescriptions, manage medicine inventory, and process prescription fulfillment.
  • Diagnostic Centers — Accept laboratory test requests, assign sample collection, process reports, and securely share results with patients and doctors.
  • Delivery & Healthcare Agents — Deliver prescribed medicines, collect diagnostic samples from patients' locations, assist with healthcare logistics, and help users access healthcare services when needed.
  • Ambulance Services — Receive emergency requests, navigate to patient locations, and coordinate with hospitals during critical situations.
  • Administrators — Verify healthcare providers, manage platform operations, monitor service quality, and oversee the entire Vaididea ecosystem.

VAIDIDEA AI SERVICE – INTELLIGENCE ENGINE (FastAPI)

WHY VAIDIDEA AI SERVICE IS 100% BACKEND-FIRST?

1
NO DIRECT LLM CALLS FROM CLIENT

(Zero Key Exposure)

  • Clients never see or store API keys.
  • All LLM calls (Groq / HuggingFace / OpenAI) are made only from this backend.
  • Keys are stored securely in .env on the server.
Patient App / Web Portals
Vaididea AI Service (FastAPI)
Groq / HF / OpenAI APIs
Keys are safe. Clients get clean results only.
2
REDIS ASYNCHRONOUS WORKER QUEUES

(No Client Timeouts)

  • AI tasks are heavy and time-consuming.
  • Requests are accepted and pushed to Redis queue.
  • Background workers process tasks without blocking clients.
  • Prevents app ANR / timeouts.
Client Request
Redis Queue (AI Tasks)
AI Worker (Background Processes)
Fast response to client. Work done in background.
3
CENTRALIZED TOKEN AUTHENTICATION

(Secure & Protected)

  • Every request is verified using tokens from Node.js Core / Supabase.
  • Only authorized Doctors / Patients can access AI services.
  • Prevents abuse and controls cloud costs.
Client Request
verify_token() (FastAPI)
Authorized Access
Security First. Access only after verification.
4
HYBRID INTELLIGENCE BEFORE AI

(Smart & Clinical)

  • Vitals & data are first analysed using rule-based clinical logic.
  • Context is built (build_vitals_context) and then sent to LLM.
  • Improves accuracy, reduces hallucinations, and saves costs.

IMPORTANT FUNCTIONS (From Codebase)
call_groq()Line ~751Sends request to Groq LLM API securely from backend.
call_huggingface()Line ~766Sends request to HuggingFace Inference API.
call_ai()Line ~819Smart router - selects model & calls appropriate LLM.
process_ai_ingest_message()Line ~267-289Receives real-time data via WebSocket and pushes to Redis queue.
ai_reasoning_worker()Line ~291-337Background worker - consumes queue and processes AI reasoning.
verify_doctor_token()Line ~733Verifies doctor token from Core Backend / Supabase.
verify_any_token()Line ~1304Verifies any user token (patient / admin / facility etc.).
analyze_vitals_for_alerts()Line ~862Rule-based clinical analysis for vitals & alert generation.
build_vitals_context()Line ~881Builds smart clinical context before sending to LLM.

TECHNICAL HIGHLIGHTS (From Codebase)
  • Redis-Backed Rate LimitingPrevents DDOS from high frequency events (e.g. GPS spam)
    1 ping per second per device enforced
  • JWT Based AuthenticationEvery socket connection is authenticated
    Unauthorized connections are rejected
  • Room Based IsolationUsers join only allowed rooms
    Data privacy & multi-tenancy ensured
  • Event Validation & SanitizationAll inputs validated before processing
    Protects from malformed / malicious data
  • Auto Reconnect & ResilienceHandles network drops in rural areas
    Queues & re-syncs missed events
  • Logging & MonitoringAll events logged with context
    Helps in debugging & audit

5. THE 12 LIVE VITALS – COMPLETE MATHEMATICAL BREAKDOWN
1

Heart Rate (HR)

Method: rPPG + Fourier Transform
Formula:
HR (bpm) = 60 × f_peak
Where f_peak = dominant frequency of BVP signal (Hz)
Source: Cheek ROI (rPPG)
Normal Range: 60 – 100 bpm
Alert: <50 or >100
2

Respiration Rate (RR)

Method: Facial / Chest Motion FFT
Formula:
RR (/min) = 60 × f_resp
Where f_resp = breathing frequency (Hz)
Source: Mouth / Chest Landmarks
Normal Range: 12 – 20 /min
Alert: <10 or >20
3

Blood Oxygen (SpO₂%)

Method: Experimental rPPG Regression
Formula:
SpO₂ = f_regression(features_rgb_ppg)
(Multiple RGB ratios → ML model)
Source: Cheek ROI (rPPG)
Normal Range: 95 – 100 %
Alert: < 90 %
4

Stress / HRV

Method: HRV from RR intervals
Metrics & Formulas:
RMSSD = √( 1/(N-1) ) × Σ (RR_{i+1} - RR_i)²
SDNN = stddev(RR_i)
Source: RR Intervals
Normal: Higher is better
Alert: Low HRV (High Stress)
5

Drowsiness (EAR)

Method: Eye Aspect Ratio (EAR)
Formula:
EAR = (||p2-p6|| + ||p3-p5||) / (2 × ||p1-p4||)
Where p1...p6 = eye landmarks
Source: Eye Landmarks
Normal Range: > 0.20
Alert: < 0.18 (Drowsy)
6

Pain Score (FACS)

Method: Facial Action Coding System
Formula:
Score = (w4·AU4) + (w6·AU6) +
(w9·AU9) + (w10·AU10) +
(w12·AU12) + (w17·AU17)
Range: 0 (No Pain) – 10 (Worst Pain)
Source: Blendshapes / FACS AU
Alert: >= 7 (Severe Pain)
7

Tremor (Neuro Risk)

Method: Head Vibration Analysis
Formula:
Tremor if (f_tremor ∈ [2.5, 5.5] Hz)
AND (amplitude > threshold)
Source: Head / Nose Landmarks
Normal: Low amplitude
Alert: High amplitude in 2.5–5.5 Hz
8

Facial Asymmetry

Method: Left vs Right Motion Diff
Formula:
Asymmetry = norm_diff(L, R)
= ||L - R||₂ / ||L + R||₂
Source: Nose, Eyes, Lips, Cheeks
Normal Range: < 0.25
Alert: > 0.60 (Stroke Indicator)
9

Pallor / Hemoglobin

Method: Color Analysis + Regression
Formula:
Hb_est = f_regression(color_features)
(Lips + Conjunctiva Color)
Source: Lips / Under Eye Area
Normal Range: > 12 g/dL
Alert: < 11 g/dL (Anemia Risk)
10

Skin Condition

Method: CNN Classifier
Formula:
class = argmax(p_i)
Where p_i = probability of class i
Source: Facial Skin ROI
Outputs: Normal / Rash / Redness /
Swelling / Acne / Others
11

Posture / Spine Angle

Method: Shoulder-Head Angle
Formula:
θ = arccos( (u · v) / (||u|| ||v||) )
Where u, v = vectors (landmarks)
Normal: 0° – 18° (Upright)
Alert: > 18° (Leaning)
Critical: > 55° (Lying Down)
12

Fall Detection

Method: Angle + Velocity Change
Formula:
fall_detected = true if
(Δθ sudden AND
vertical_velocity < -V_th)
Source: Spine Angle + Motion
Output: Boolean (True / False)
Alert: True → SOS Trigger

CRON SCHEDULE
  • Every 6 hours (4 times/day)
  • Redis Distributed Lock
  • Window: Last 3 days vs 30-day baseline
SEVERITY CLASSIFICATION
Condition Cases
(3 days)		 Final Z-
Score		 Severity Color
≥ 30 OR ≥ 4.0 CRITICAL Red
≥ 15 OR ≥ 3.0 WARNING Yellow
≥ 8 OR ≥ 2.0 WATCH Blue
< 8 AND < 2.0 NORMAL Green
MODIFIED Z-SCORE FORMULA
  • daily_current = event_count_3_days / 3
  • baseline_mean = Σ(daily_counts_last_27_days) / 27
  • baseline_variance = Σ(daily_count_i - mean)² / 27
  • baseline_stddev = √variance
  • z_score = (daily_current - baseline_mean) / stddev
SPATIAL CLUSTERING MULTIPLIER
  • radius < 5 km → multiplier = 1.5 (50% boost)
  • radius < 10 km → multiplier = 1.2 (20% boost)
  • radius ≥ 10 km → multiplier = 1.0 (no boost)
final_z_score = z_score * spatialMultiplier
AUTO-RESOLUTION (Layer 3)
If current_cases < 3 in 3-day window
→ Alert status = 'resolved' automatically.
MINIMUM DATA GUARD (Layer 4)
If baseline_mean < 0.1 AND cases < 5 → SKIP
(Too early / insufficient data)

cases < 5 → skip		 New cities with too

1. SMART DOCTOR RECOMMENDATION ENGINE (AI MATCHING)

4-LAYER INTELLIGENT SIGNAL SCORING
1
Chatbot Memory Extraction
Weight: 3 * hits
Scan last 20 chatbot messages
Example: "chest pain" → Cardiology +3
2
Follow-Up Anchor
Weight: 2
Check last 10 consultations
Example: Previous Neurology visit → +2
3
Chronic Condition Profile
Weight: 1 * hits
Scan medical_conditions
Example: "diabetes" → Endocrinology +1
4
Location & Mode Preference
Boost: +20 (Same City) | +5 (Telemedicine)
Nearby doctors get priority
COMPOSITE SCORING FORMULA
baseScore = (rating * 10)
            + (log10(reviews + 1) * 5)
            + (experience_years * 0.5)

specScore = (specializationScore * 15)

scoreBoost = 0
if (sameCity) scoreBoost += 20
if (videoConsultation) scoreBoost += 5

finalScore = baseScore + specScore + scoreBoost
RESULT
Doctors sorted by finalScore (High → Low)
Reason shown to patient
(e.g., "Based on your recent symptoms (Nearby)")

2. WEBRTC SIGNALING & SOCKET.IO SECURITY

SIGNALING PIPELINE
video:join
Join room → get video:room-state
(prevents race conditions)
video:offer
Send SDP offer to peer
video:answer
Send SDP answer to peer
video:ice-candidate
Exchange ICE candidates
video:ai_proof
Broadcast AI predictions
(live vitals, alerts, etc.)
video:disconnect
Clean leave & room cleanup
EPHEMERAL TURN AUTHENTICATION (24 HOURS)
Why? → Static credentials can be misused.
expiry = currentTime + 24 * 3600
username = '${expiry}:${userId}'
password = HMAC_SHA1(turnCredential, username)

iceServers = [ STUN(Google) + TURN(Ephemeral) ]
Benefits
  • Short-lived (24h) credentials
  • User-specific authentication
  • Prevents abuse & unauthorized access
  • Secure STUN/TURN connection establishment

3. WEBRTC AUTO-DEGRADATION (VIDEO ↔ AUDIO ↔ CHAT)

REAL-TIME METRIC POLLING (Every 1 Second)
RTT (Round Trip Time)
From "candidate-pair"
currentRoundTripTime
Packet Loss (%)
From "remote-inbound-rtp"
packetsLost / packetsSent
NETWORK STATE CLASSIFICATION
EXCELLENT Loss < 1% & RTT < 100ms
GOOD 1% ≤ Loss ≤ 12% & 100ms ≤ RTT ≤ 600ms
POOR Loss > 12% OR RTT > 600ms
CRITICAL Loss > 25% OR RTT > 1200ms
HYSTERESIS STATE MACHINE
(Stable Transitions)
EXCELLENT / GOOD
Stable Connection
POOR → Switch to AUDIO ONLY
Camera Off + Audio Continues
CRITICAL → Switch to CHAT MODE
Audio Off + Chat Enabled
RESTORE CONDITIONS (Stable)
Back to AUDIO → VIDEO
HYSTERESIS BUFFERS
(Avoid UI Flashing)
POOR → CRITICAL
Delay: 3 Seconds
CRITICAL → POOR
Delay: 5 Seconds
UI Banner Clear Delay
6 - 8 Seconds
Prevents mode
flashing due to
momentary spikes

4. FALLBACK CHAT & GUARDIAN PAYLOAD

ROBUST CHAT SOCKETS
socket.to(room).emit()
Sender doesn't receive own message
(prevents duplicate bubbles)
chat:message:sent ack
Reliable delivery confirmation
Redis Rate Limiting
Max 5 msgs/sec | 200ms gap
2000 chars limit

2. REDIS-BASED QUOTA MANAGEMENT

How It Works
Redis Key Pattern:
diet:quota:{userId}:{YYYY-MM-DD}
1
Check Quota (Before Processing)
GET diet:quota:{userId}:{today}
2
If count >= FREE_DAILY_LIMIT (5)
→ Return HTTP 429
(Too Many Requests)
3
If allowed → INCREMENT quota
(INCR key)
4
Process request
(Vision or Calculation)
5
On Success → Quota stays consumed
Refund Logic (Robustness)
If Vision AI Fails or Times Out
(> 60 seconds)
OR
Any Server Error Occurs
Call refundDietQuota(userId)
→ DECR diet:quota:{userId}:{today}
User's quota is
refunded (not wasted)
FREE_DAILY_LIMIT = 5 (Per User Per Day)
Limit resets automatically next day (00:00 UTC)

2. SMART RANKING ALGORITHM – "BEST DOCTORS FIRST"

How Doctors are Ranked (In-Memory Smart Score)
Smart Score = (Rating × 10) + (log10(Reviews + 1) × 5)

Rating is Primary Driver

Logarithmic Review Scaling
Rewards experience, but avoids unfair advantage to doctors with huge review counts
Quality Over Quantity
A 5★ doctor with 100 reviews can rank higher than a 4★ doctor with 10,000 reviews

Smart Score in
descending order.
You always see the best quality doctors on top!

2. SORTING & RANKING ANSWERS (CLINICAL PRIORITY)

When Patient opens
a Question
What causes acidity after meals?
Asked by Patient • 2 hours ago

Dr. Amit Sharma Verified

1 hour ago

4.6
18

Dr. Old Account Not Verified
4.2
45
Try home remedies like...
3 hours ago
Sorting Logic (Backend)
Answers are sorted in two levels to show the most reliable information first.
1
Primary Sort
Verified Doctors always come first
2
Secondary Sort
Among same type, highest upvotes first
Result
Verified & most helpful answers always appear on top.
How it Works (communityService.js)
answers.sort((a, b) => {
  // 1. Primary Sort: Verified doctors first
  if (a.is_doctor_verified !== b.is_doctor_verified) {
    return a.is_doctor_verified ? -1 : 1;
  }
  // 2. Secondary Sort: Highest upvotes next
  return b.upvotes - a.upvotes;
});
If a doctor's verification is removed, their answers automatically move to the bottom, keeping patients safe.

3. UPVOTE SPAM PROTECTION (REDIS DISTRIBUTED LOCKS)

1. User Clicks Upvote
Patient taps
Thumbs Up
on an answer
2. Request to Backend
App sends request
to backend
3. Redis Lock Check
Backend tries to create
a unique lock key
4A. Lock Exists
Already upvoted!
Request rejected
(No duplicate count)
If New Key
5. Upvote Created
Lock created
successfully
6. Lock Duration
Upvote count
increased in
database
Each user can upvote the same question or answer only once in 1 year.
Prevents spam and fake inflation of scores.
How Redis Lock Works
  • Backend uses Redis SETNX to create a unique key for user + answer.
  • If key exists → reject request.
  • If key is new → allow & save upvote.
  • Lock key auto-expires in 1 year.

VAIDIDEA REVIEWS & RATINGS ENGINE (DEEP DIVE)

Trust • Transparency • Quality Care for Everyone

SWASTIK uses a centralized, highly secure Review & Rating Engine to ensure genuine feedback, prevent misuse,
and help patients find the best healthcare providers.

1
UNIFIED REVIEW SYSTEM (ONE TABLE FOR ALL)

Instead of separate tables for each service, SWASTIK uses
one smart system for everything.

Single Reviews Table

  • reviewable_type
  • reviewable_id
  • consultation_id
  • rating
  • review_text
  • is_anonymous
  • patient_id
  • created_at

Works for All Services

  • Doctors
  • Hospitals
  • Clinics
  • Pharmacies
  • Diagnostic Centers

One system. One place. All feedback connected.

Easy to manage • Easy to scale • Accurate insights

2
ANTI-SPAM & DOUBLE-COUNTING PROTECTIONS

A. Linked to a Specific Visit

1. Patient had a
consultation

2. Patient leaves
a review

3. Only one review
allowed per visit

If patient tries again for the same visit →
Old review is updated, not duplicated.

B. General Reviews (No Visit)

1. Patient writes a
general review

2. System checks
existing review

3. Only one active
review per entity

If patient writes again →
Old review is overwritten.
Prevents fake reviews, review-bombing and unfair ratings.
3
REAL-TIME SCORE AGGREGATION

As soon as a review is added or updated,
scores are instantly updated.

1. Review
Submitted

2. System calculates
new average

4.6

3. New rating
(e.g., 4.6)

4. Updated everywhere
in real-time

Ratings directly impact doctor visibility in search results.

Better reviews = More trust = More patients

4
PRIVACY WITH "LATE-STAGE ANONYMIZATION"

How It Works

1. System stores
patient info
securely

2. Review is marked
as "Anonymous"

3. Personal info is hidden
before showing to
the public

Names are hidden,

But system still knows who reviewed
(for security & anti-spam).

Anonymous

2 hours ago

"Very good experience.
Doctor explained
everything clearly."

No identity revealed to the public
5
FOREIGN KEY FALLBACK MECHANISM

Sometimes app sends wrong
appointment link.

Wrong link
(invalid ID)

Database link
may fail

System still saves
review successfully

What Happens?

  • If link is invalid → System
    removes strict link
  • Review is still saved
  • Doctor rating is still updated
  • User never faces an error

No frustration. No data loss.

Every review counts!

6
BROADER IMPACT - SMART DISCOVERY TRIAGE

SWASTIK intelligently decides what matters more:
Quality or Proximity based on patient's need.

A. QUALITY-FIRST (Standard Care)

Used for: Doctors, Clinics,
Normal Hospitals

  • Considers ratings + reviews
  • Expert quality comes first
  • Better care, even if slightly farther
Goal: Best Quality Care

B. PROXIMITY-FIRST (Emergency & Urgent)

Used for: Emergency Hospitals,
Pharmacies

  • Considers distance only
  • Nearest provider comes first
  • Saves time in critical situations
Goal: Fastest Help Available

Right care. Right place. Right time.

Because every second counts.

VAIDIDEA AI Vitals Architecture (Two-Tier Computer Vision)
Tier 1 – Intelligent Landmark Detection

Runs periodically to detect stable facial landmarks

  • • Face Detection
  • • Landmark Mapping
  • • ROI Selection
  • • Facial Geometry
  • • Motion Reference
  • • Illumination Handling
Tier 2 – Lightweight Signal Extraction

Runs continuously on selected regions (ROIs)

  • • rPPG for Heart Rate
  • • Respiratory Signal
  • • Skin Color Variation
  • • Motion Analysis
  • • Noise Filtering
  • • Continuous Monitoring
This two-tier architecture minimizes computation while maximizing accuracy and battery efficiency.

Executive Summary

VAIDIDEA is built with an Offline-First philosophy. Instead of failing when the internet is unavailable, the app continues to work, saves every action locally, and automatically synchronizes when the network returns. This architecture is designed specifically for India's rural and low-connectivity reality.

Store & Forward Architecture

1
Action Performed (Offline)
2
Saved Locally (Secure)
3
Queued For Sync
4
Auto Sync When Online

Smart Sync Engine

  • Intelligent queue management
  • Batch & compress data before syncing
  • Conflict resolution & data consistency
  • Exponential backoff for retry
  • Sync only what's changed

Fragmented Records

Patient data scattered across hospitals, clinics and apps.

No Continuity of Care

No single platform to track the complete health journey.

Hospital-Centric Model

Care happens only in hospitals, not in daily life.

Manual & Paper Based

Reports, prescriptions and records are still manual in many places.

Rural Accessibility Gap

Limited access to quality healthcare in rural & remote areas.

Reactive Healthcare

We treat diseases after they become severe.

No Preventive Intelligence

Early detection, risk prediction and preventive care are missing.

Data Silos

Data is locked in systems and cannot talk to each other.

No Unified Ecosystem

Patients, providers and systems are not connected.

3. HEALTHCARE STANDARDS ROADMAP
STANDARD PURPOSE
ABDM (Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission)National digital health infrastructure and interoperability
ABHA (Ayushman Bharat Health Account)Unique digital health identity for every citizen
FHIR (Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources)Interoperable exchange of healthcare information
HL7 (Health Level Seven)Clinical and administrative data exchange standards
DICOM (Digital Imaging and Communications)Medical imaging communication and storage
ICD-10 / ICD-11 (WHO)International disease classification standards
SNOMED CTClinical terminology for consistent healthcare data
LOINC (Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes)Standard for lab & clinical observations
HIPAA PrinciplesPrivacy, security and compliance principles
GDPR PrinciplesGlobal data protection and privacy regulations
Designed for interoperability, portability and long-term compatibility.
